rows.grounds: From context: installation around a prasāda/sanctuary; genitive indicating location/association (of the shrine).
Locative plural indicating placement in the four directions around the shrine.
Fused token as given (sandhi fusion marked in form by elision); conveys placement in the fire direction and in the Īśa direction, followed by 'then' in sequence of installation steps.
Nominative plural subject/object in this procedural list: pavilions to be set up/placed.

items.question: In which directional locations around the shrine are the pavilions to be established in this installation step?
premises: Pavilions are designated for placement in this rite.
Placement is specified relative to the shrine in multiple directions.
Directional placements include the fire direction and the Īśa direction in sequence.
items.inference: The verse directs that pavilions be set up in the four directions of the shrine and then in the fire and Īśa directions as part of the installation procedure.
uncertainties: Exact mapping of vahnāvīśe'tha into two locatives plus 'atha' is inferred from the legacy hint and context; internal sandhi boundaries not split because token is fused as given.
items.plain_english: Pavilions are to be placed in the four directions of the shrine, and then in the fire direction and in the Īśa direction.
